_readme: Layer configuration. After re-organising layers in Rhino, edit this file only (no code changes). Layers are matched by full Rhino path (e.g. GroundFloor::glass).
_stairGroups: Order = list order in the panel. tier = vertical explode level (members of one tier rise together). hiddenWhenAssembled = inner layers hidden when the stair is assembled. finish: microcement / oak (grain radial|tangential) / floor / room / wood / plaster / steel / glass / plain. spec = text shown when a part is picked; tbc = item still to be confirmed. coat = applied finish (e.g. micro-cement): in the construction sequence it fades in place instead of being installed panel by panel. seamless = weld shading normals across block joints. assembledAs = when the stair is assembled, show this (hidden) layer with that group's finish as a backing so joints never show through. explode: {dir: up | down | lateral (away from the stair, each side its own way) | zone (soffit parts down, wall-head parts up, wall panels sideways) | none, dist: mm}. mergeSides: merge all pieces into one per side of the stair (handrail).

_sequence: Construction sequence (chapter 04 / Build sequence), one entry per step, in order. group/groups = stair group ids; include/exclude filter by blocks (Rhino block names), orientation (vertical | horizontal) or zone (soffit = under the flight, cap = on the wall heads, wall = wall panels). motion: appear (shown in place), drop (from above), rise (from below), slide (in from outside the stair), grow (revealed from the bottom up), coat (fades in place). seconds = step duration. camera: 'soffit' turns the camera to look up at the underside of the stair for that step. motion mitre: tread boards come down and riser boards come in from the front so the 45° mitred nosing is seen closing; camera 'mitre' = side view with the near wall hidden. corner: steel joints pushed diagonally into the step corner, one step at a time. fade: appears in place (large curved panels), one after another. hint: caption-only pause announcing the next trade. with: 'previous' runs at the same time as the step before (same caption) — large panels appear quietly while the small pre-blocked panels are placed. delay: seconds of pause before the step (e.g. while the camera turns).

sequence.label: Finishing: micro-cement, trowelled on by hand

_contextLayers: Everything that is not the stair. Shown in the 'With interior' mode and when 'Building' is on. inner = hidden by default. depthRank = draw order for surfaces that coincide (0 = in front), prevents flicker where floor layers share a plane. buried = covered by other finishes: skipped while the building fades in / out (semi-transparent stacked layers flicker).

_stairOnlyExclude: Parts on stair layers that belong to the ground floor (upstand soffit, GF handrail, caps). They are hidden in 'Stair only' and fade in with the building. Matched by Rhino object id, or by bounding-box centre inside a box (Rhino coordinates, mm).
_explode: Layers move as whole skins (no per-panel spread). Direction per part from its zone: under the flight → down, on the wall heads / treads → up, wall panels → sideways, each side away from the stair. Distance = layer depth (core stays).
